assumptions.text: Two copper layers; through vias only. This layout does not verify circuit function.

blockInstances.label: B1
blockInstances.name: LED indicator
notes: Example only: 1 kΩ series resistor and generic LED. Check LED forward voltage, GPIO drive limits and resistor power at the actual supply.
No supply voltage or safe current is inferred from a net name. Verify the purchased LED polarity and lead pitch.

blockInstances.label: B2
blockInstances.name: Button with pull-up
notes: 10 kΩ is a starting value, not a universal requirement. Verify logic voltage, input thresholds and debounce in the receiving circuit.
Generic four-lead switch assumes left pair 1–2 and right pair 3–4 are common; verify the actual switch with a meter. Switch state is not simulated.

blockInstances.label: B3
blockInstances.name: I²C pull-up pair
notes: Review the combined pull-up resistance of every device on the bus, bus capacitance, speed and voltage before using 4.7 kΩ.
This is not a voltage level shifter. VCC must suit all connected bus devices; firmware and addressing are outside this layout.

blockInstances.label: B4
blockInstances.name: Supply decoupling pair
notes: Move the ceramic capacitor close to the actual IC supply pin and keep its return loop short. A prearranged group does not guarantee effective decoupling.
Select capacitor voltage rating, dielectric, ESR, ripple capability and actual footprint; the radial capacitor is a nominal template.

blockInstances.label: B5
blockInstances.name: Fused, series-diode DC input
notes: Unqualified low-voltage topology template. Select exact fuse, diode and capacitor ratings for supply voltage, fault current, load, temperature and voltage drop.
Not a mains circuit, surge suppressor, battery charger, regulator, or safety-certified protection design. Trace width is 0.4 mm, NOT a current rating.
Generic PTC and Schottky footprints require actual-part review before ordering. The diode anode faces the input; its cathode feeds VOUT.

blockInstances.label: B6
blockInstances.name: RC input filter
notes: Starting values only. Check bandwidth, source impedance, ADC acquisition time, input protection and the load; this is not an anti-aliasing certification.
The PCB layout does not simulate the signal or infer its voltage. Adjust the values and placement for the real receiving circuit.
